g.data-info: Parenchyma that fills the stem; it is not divided into cortex, endodermis and pith in a monocot.
A ring of sclerenchyma fibres around each vascular bundle that strengthens it.
Sieve tubes and companion cells on the outer side of each bundle that carry food.
Two large vessels in each bundle that carry most of the water upward.
Small first-formed xylem vessels on the inner side of each bundle.
A water-filled cavity left where the oldest protoxylem broke down.
A few layers of thick-walled sclerenchyma under the epidermis that give mechanical strength.
Outer protective layer of cells covered by a cuticle.
